info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fitness Memberships Billings-v3-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Billing Inquiry API provides access to detailed billing information for fitness memberships. This endpoint allows businesses to retrieve data regarding member billing cycles, outstanding balances, and payment history. Typical consumers include gym management systems and financial reporting tools, which utilize this information for managing subscriptions and member accounts. The API aims to enhance operational efficiency by streamlining billing information retrieval, crucial for customer service and financial reconciliation.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the billing details associated with membership accounts. It provides insights into payment history, current billing status, and other relevant financial data for users who have a membership.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving billing details of memberships. This body contains the necessary parameters to access the specific billing information relevant to the user's account.

ListFitnessMembershipsBillingsRequest.title: Request Body for Memberships Billing Operations
ListFitnessMembershipsBillingsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body format for the GET operation related to memberships billing. It is defined as a string, which typically contains JSON data.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the billing operation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the billing operation.

state.description: Current state of the billing operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message regarding the result of the operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the billing operation.

ListFitnessMembershipsBillingsResponse_2.description: Response object for the billing operations GET request, indicating the processing status and audit details.

createdBy.description: User who created the billing operation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the billing operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the operation was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Contains details about the audit of the billing operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A value of 0 indicates that the processing time was negligible.
